title: Decide Babulus's Prospectus integration choices
description:
Decisions needed from Ryan before building:
1. Sign-in: an app client in the shared Prospectus Cognito pool (the Cyclotron Lab pattern, recommended by the Prospectus session: one Google login across Anthus products) vs a Babulus pool with a Google-only client (the Papyrus pattern).
2. Product shape: a single product named `babulus`?
3. Can a signed-in person create their own organization account, or only operators?
4. Role mapping: Babulus's `editor` role has no Prospectus equivalent; map it to `member`?
Record the answers here; they shape every other task in this epic.
